description:
Endeavor is real-world enterprise AI.



Our software is the distribution layer for powerful AI models that will build the world.

Our belief is that AI will power many applications in legal, healthcare, and finance. But none are more important than building AI that can build the world around us. Especially the physical infrastructure that will accelerate the development of AI.

We focus on the building materials market, which is suffering from manual quoting, order entry, and pricing. These are a double whammy. They lose revenue for missed quotes and mispriced products. And they pay tons of people to make quotes and enter orders. AI solves that, so our product is flying off the shelves. After we dominate this market, we’ll go to other industries. But we have to win this market first - if we don’t, we don’t get to the next level.

While labs build the models of the future, we build the last-mile delivery for them. We must model complex environments, deliver reliable results, and bridge the gap between models and the antiquated ecosystems in which they must operate.



Our Principles:

 - We are bold, especially when the world tells us what we’re doing is impossible.

 - We are truth-seeking, choosing clarity over comfort.

 - We will win. And we work really hard to win.
   
   

The Role | Forward Deployed Engineer

Forward Deployed Engineers work side by side with our customers, rapidly understanding their toughest issues; architecting and building solutions that leverage business-critical data and the latest advancements in AI to solve them. As a FDE, your contributions will have a direct impact on our customers’ missions and the real world. You’ll work in small, agile teams and own the end-to-end execution and implementation of high-stakes projects.



What We Require

 - High agency, slope, and chaos ceiling with strong first principles thinking, outcome orientation, and resiliency.

 - Engineering background, preferred in fields such as Computer Science, Mathematics, Software Engineering, Physics, and Data Science.

 - Proficiency with one or more programming languages, such as Python, C++, TypeScript/JavaScript, or similar.

 - Must be graduating in 2026 or before.

 - Ability to travel.
